adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }` catch block discards the caught `err` and logs only a static string. This makes email-sending failures difficult to diagnose because no error details/stack are recorded.
